about: Golden questions for Ask District IQ. Expected numbers are never written here: each case gives SQL (run on district_intel at test time, with ? = the data's as-of time) or names the console function whose numbers the answer must contain, because the data changes with every pipeline build. The evaluator checks: intent, tool or plan, reply language, refusals, display, and that every expected number appears in the answer (after rounding) with no unverified number.
asOfSql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(first_reported_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS v FROM incidents

cases.q: Which zone needs attention now?

numbers.label: top attention score
numbers.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE severity_level WHEN 'Severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS v FROM incidents WHERE first_reported_at > (? - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND first_reported_at <= ? AND zone_no IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zone_no ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

cases.q: Severe incidents this week by department

numbers.label: top department's severe count
numbers.sql: SELECT SUM(severity_level = 'Severe') AS v FROM incidents WHERE first_reported_at > (? - INTERVAL 168 HOUR) AND first_reported_at <= ? GROUP BY lead_dept ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

cases.q: Road accident trend for the last 30 days

numbers.label: total
numbers.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM incidents WHERE category_code = 'ROAD_ACCIDENT' AND first_reported_at > (? - INTERVAL 720 HOUR) AND first_reported_at <= ?

cases.q: Which hospitals are above 90% beds today?

numbers.label: highest occupancy
numbers.sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(value), 1) AS v FROM observation_signals WHERE metric = 'bed_occupancy_pct' AND observed_at <= ?

cases.q: Which lakes are more than 90% full?

numbers.label: lakes above 90%
numbers.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM observation_signals WHERE metric = 'lake_pct_full' AND value > 90 AND observed_at <= ?

Incidents in the news but not in department records

numbers.label: news-only incidents, 7 days
numbers.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM incidents WHERE media_only = 1 AND status_std <> 'Lapsed' AND first_reported_at > (? - INTERVAL 168 HOUR) AND first_reported_at <= ?
